changelog:
Initial release of GDPR Compliance Skill.

- Produces a comprehensive GDPR assessment: ROPA, lawful-basis mapping, DSAR workflow, DPIA trigger screen, and prioritised gap list.
- Outlines required inputs (processing activities, role, data types, data subjects, transfers).
- Includes programmatic helper to validate and score ROPA completeness.
- Lists quality checks and common anti-patterns to avoid.
- Provides formatted output for clear, auditable compliance documentation.
